prompt: Use case: product-mockup. One complete realistic modular steel roadside guardrail section for an industrial port racing track. 4 meters long, about 0.85 meters tall, galvanized silver-gray corrugated W-beam horizontal rail attached by visible bolts to three evenly spaced sturdy steel posts with small flat mounting baseplates. Straight square ends suitable for repeated joining. Fine zinc texture and restrained rust at bolts, realistic slight weathering, structurally intact. Clear three-quarter view showing rail profile and support posts, whole silhouette with generous margins. No concrete wall, no ground slab, no road, no scenery, no text. Neutral diffuse studio lighting on a plain light gray background.
